entities.title: Documentation
entities.summary: Why UTV exists, the contracts every library implements, the example catalogue and the generated side-by-side page.
entities.purpose: Holds what sits between the specification and the libraries: the rationale for readers (rationale.md); the language-neutral question catalogue (operations.md); the library contracts (everyday-api.md for the 0.2 JSON layer, library-api.md for the 0.3 typed layer, text-form.md for utv-text/1); the example scenario catalogue (example-tests.md); the review the 0.3 contract came from (aesthetics-review.md); and side-by-side.md.
boundaries: Not normative for the wire format: the specification and the schema are. text-form.md is an interchange adapter that adds no kinds or properties.
Where docs/everyday-api.md and conformance/operations/everyday.json disagree, the fixtures are the arbiter and the disagreement is raised.
side-by-side.md is generated by tools/side_by_side.py from the libraries' UTV-first tests and is never edited by hand.
